preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of stones N is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N and len(B) == N for A, B, N in zip(As, Bs, Ns))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the lengths of Alice's and Bob's stone strings A and B are equal to N.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() for c in A) and all(c.islower() for c in B) for A, B in zip(As, Bs))
preconditions.description: All characters in Alice's and Bob's stone strings A and B are lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.expression: all(len(S) == 2 * N for S, N in zip(Ss, Ns))
postconditions.description: The length of the final string S for each test case is twice the number of stones N.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() for c in S) for S in Ss)
postconditions.description: All characters in the final string S for each test case are lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.expression: all(S == ''.join(sorted(A + B)) if i % 2 == 0 else S == ''.join(sorted(A + B)[::-1]) for i, (S, A, B) in enumerate(zip(Ss, As, Bs)))
postconditions.description: The final string S is formed by interleaving the sorted stones of Alice and Bob optimally.
